routes.name: Bulgarian citizenship (grant by the Vice President)
routes.summary: Bulgarian citizenship is granted by decree of the Vice President, on a proposal from the Minister of Justice and a report from the Commission on Bulgarian Citizenship. Years of residence, language rules and dual citizenship were not confirmed.

other: Residence years, language test, and dual citizenship rules not confirmed from an official page. Check the Bulgarian Citizenship Act and the Ministry of Justice.

citizenship.note: Since a 2022 decree, the Vice President handles granting and restoring citizenship. Details need review.

routes.name: Short stay in Bulgaria (Schengen rules)
routes.summary: Bulgaria is in the Schengen area, so Schengen short-stay rules apply. The Ministry of Interior has an ETIAS section for visa-exempt travelers. Visa-free list, 90/180 day rule and fees were not confirmed from an official page.

other: Which nationalities are visa-free, and the exact stay limits, not confirmed. Check the Ministry of Interior ETIAS pages and mfa.bg visa pages.
